page_title: ACM 1-2 CAG | AC Milan v Cagliari 24/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Marco Guida is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' The free kick is taken by Luka Modric (AC Milan), but ball is cleared.
90+6' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) for a tough tackle.
90+5' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
90+5' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mattia Felici (Cagliari) is coming onto the pitch as Sebastiano Esposito cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90+4' AC Milan take a short corner kick.
90+2' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Luka Modric (AC Milan) takes it short.

88' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar! The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
87' Paul Mendy (Cagliari) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the middle of the goal is smartly dealt with by Mike Maignan.
86' Luka Modric (AC Milan) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.

84' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
82' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

80' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) covers his face with his hands after spurning a great chance. The ball rebounded to him but his close-range header went well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AC Milan comes to nothing.

79' Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. AC Milan will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

78' Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to AC Milan.
77' Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.

76' He should have scored! Michel Adopo (Cagliari) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom right corner is pretty weak and Mike Maignan makes an easy save.
74' Here is a change. Alessandro Deiola is going off and Fabio Pisacane gives the last tactical orders to Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari).
74' Substitution. Gennaro Borrelli is replaced by Paul Mendy (Cagliari).
73' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) quickly picks up the rebound and drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.

73' Mike Maignan pulls off a great save to deny Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
72' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.

71' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! AC Milan are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
69' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
68' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Youssouf Fofana and he is replaced by Rafael Leao (AC Milan).
68' The attendance is 74593.
66' 3:6 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
63' Today's match ends for Jose Pedro who will be replaced by Marco Palestra (Cagliari).
62' Here comes a substitution. Juan Rodriguez is given a rest as he is replaced by Alberto Dossena (Cagliari).
62' Substitution. Luka Modric (AC Milan) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ardon Jashari walks off.
61' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) replacing Christopher Nkunku.
61' The referee allows time for a substitution. Fikayo Tomori will be replaced by Zachary Athekame (AC Milan).
61' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
58' Mike Maignan (AC Milan) gets a yellow card for protesting.
57' 1 - 2 Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the bottom right corner, and thus alter the score to 1:2.
56' Today's referee Marco Guida rightly decides to book Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) for his harsh tackle.
55' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
54' Adam Obert (Cagliari) commits a rough challenge and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Adam Obert (Cagliari) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
51' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
48' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
46' Massimiliano Allegri has made a change at the break. Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) has come on in place of Santiago Tomas Gimenez.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.

45+1' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Marco Guida couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) and blew his whistle.
40' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Mike Maignan easily deals with the threat.
37' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mike Maignan, who smothers the ball.
34' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
33' Adam Obert (Cagliari) brings an opponent down and Marco Guida interrupts the game. AC Milan win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
32' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
32' AC Milan will take a corner kick.
32' The ball is cleared after Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. AC Milan will take a corner kick.
30' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
30' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
28' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
26' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Elia Caprile.
24' Marco Guida blows the whistle, Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) is penalised for a foul.

22' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
22' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to AC Milan.
20' 1 - 1 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Yerry Mina knock down. 1:1.
20' Adam Obert (Cagliari) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
19' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
17' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marco Guida no option but to blow his whistle.
15' Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
14' A corner kick by Cagliari is thwarted by the well prepared Mike Maignan (AC Milan).
13' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
9' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
8' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
7' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
5' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

2' 1 - 0 Goal! Santiago Tomas Gimenez shows great vision to find Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
2' Jose Pedro (Cagliari) sees a yellow card from Marco Guida after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

The players are out at last! Cagliari will take the kick-off.
